audit_name: MECT Donation Flow Security & Compliance Verification

authentication_controls.endpoint_level: POST /api/donations/public/initiate in Java Spring Boot requires non-null portalUserId
authentication_controls.frontend_level: Step 2 of DonationJourney prompts for OTP authentication or guest donor details entry

rate_limiting.limit: 5 requests per 60 seconds per IP address

input_validation.donor_phone: 10-digit mobile number validation with numeric stripping
input_validation.donor_pan: Optional for general donors, mandatory for Section 80G tax exemption; regex: /^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}$/
input_validation.amount: Minimum INR 1 voluntary contribution; boundary validated against NaN and negative amounts
input_validation.utr_reference: 8 to 40 characters alphanumeric format matching Indian banking UTR standards

fail_closed_posture.policy: If backend database or verification service is offline, endpoint returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
fail_closed_posture.prohibition: Under NO circumstances is a synthetic reference number generated or displayed to real donors when backend fails to record the submission
fail_closed_posture.dev_fallback_guard: ALLOW_DEV_FALLBACK is honoured strictly during test harnesses and never in production

statutory_compliance_and_dpdp.80g_receipt_issuance: Status remains strictly UNVERIFIED (Pending Bank Reconciliation) until verified against official SBI bank ledger
statutory_compliance_and_dpdp.communication_consent: Explicit checkbox for institutional annual updates
statutory_compliance_and_dpdp.whatsapp_consent: Explicit, unbundled opt-in checkbox per Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act; default FALSE
